model_output.score_comment_short: The research work is specific, but the marketing bullets need more detail.
model_output.score_comment_long: Your research role names the data, tool, and study. The credit union bullets describe activities without explaining your contributions in much detail. Revising the manager claim and expanding the marketing work would make the resume easier to assess.
model_output.score_plain: The resume shows early-career experience, but a reviewer may have trouble assessing your marketing responsibilities. More detail about the work you actually did would help.
model_output.first_impression: The opening presents you as a marketing manager, while the listed credit union position is an internship. The research entry is more detailed than the marketing entry.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Helped with the member newsletter" does not say what you contributed, so a reviewer cannot tell what part of the publication you handled.
model_output.summary: Your credit union internship combines newsletter, social media, and branch event work, but the opening claim of campaign leadership goes beyond what those bullets explain. The listed roles suggest an early-career level, with any management experience needing further support. Cleaning survey data from 1,200 dairy farms in Stata for a pricing study is worth keeping because it shows a concrete analytical task and its purpose. The resume ends in May 2024, leaving any more recent activity unclear.
strengths: Posting to credit union social media accounts places you in a member-facing marketing channel.
Writing 15 literature summaries on farm subsidies shows a defined research deliverable.
Leading tours for groups of up to 25 prospective students adds a concrete public-speaking example.
gaps: The summary says you led campaigns from strategy to launch, but the experience section does not describe that leadership or a campaign.
The branch event bullet does not explain which planning tasks you supported, making your contribution difficult to distinguish.
No activity after May 2024 is listed, so a reviewer may wonder what you have done since the internship ended.
